no_api_findings.finding: The versioned standard-library package list has no MPEG audio frame parser or Layer III decoder. encoding/binary reads generic numeric fields and io moves bytes; neither interprets MPEG frame headers, side info or main data.

limit: This is a finding about documented Go 1.27.1 standard-library APIs, not platform media frameworks or third-party modules. It matches the mp3_id3v2 Go finding in data/go/mp3_id3v2/standard.json.
